## Snallygaster background

The Snallygasters are **cryptids** and are probably one of the most famous FEV experiments that were bred and escaped from the West Tek Research Center. The Snallygaster has six limbs, numerous eyes on its back, and an elongated tongue covered in acidic slime that can quickly hunt down any survivors.

The first variation comes from FEVS-006443 from October 14, 2077 and combines several species. The results were considered worrying by scientists, but provided valuable insight into the performance of recombinant FEV. The live, stable subject behaved normally and was scheduled to be released in Huntersville upon completion of the subsequent experiment. The mutant was able to escape the facility and has since spread throughout Appalachia.

Snallygasters are immune to radiation and take 150% damage from hits to the head.

## Snallygaster locations

- **[100% spawn chance]** - **Flooded depot**
 - **Toxic Larry's Meat'n Go**
 - **Charleston**
between Hornwright Industrial Headquarters and Charleston Capitol Building
 - **Federal Waste Disposal Office HZ-21**
 - **Hemlock Holes**
 - **[Instance] Vault 96**
- **[50% Spawn Chance]** - **Kiddie Corner Huts**
 - **The Bounty**
- **[15-33% Spawn Chance]** - **Pylon V-13**
 - **Treetops**
 - **Beckwith Farm**
